measurement_method: Exact turn usage, deduplicated by response_id. Wall time from task_started to final assistant message. Tool time is union of top-level tool call/output intervals; includes orchestration overhead, excludes any background work outside those intervals. Phase boundaries rounded to source events; phase labels do not imply exclusive CPU task attribution.
findings: 107 serial tool boundaries dominate iteration overhead; top-level tool intervals account for only about 6% of wall time.
Existing font and image bootstrap requirements were not enforced before initial render.
Node layout bounds were used where original asset export bounds were required; export size data was already present in MCP evidence.
Contract initialization leaves all node decisions pending; a new 215-line page-specific preparation script was authored.
78 of 106 covered inventory entries refer only to whole-page region metrics; coverage count is not equivalent to independent visual assurance.
R2 automated acceptance missed missing-glyph boxes because text detector checked position and size only.
Previous runtime log incorrectly stated token telemetry unavailable.
